name: FV_DATA_ACT_REP_TRX_ACTIVITY
description: This table stores information about the transaction details from gl_je_headers and gl_je_lines for the ussgl accounts defined to calculate DATA Act balances.

columns.name: REPORT_TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the gl transactions that are used for the file generation.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ledger.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield combination defining column

columns.name: PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Accounting period number code of Oracle Fusion General Ledger balance.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Accounting period year code of Oracle Fusion General Ledger balance.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.description: The program activity code for the agency defined in federal attribute supplemental rules.

columns.name: PARK_CODE
columns.description: The Program Activity Reporting Key for the agency defined in federal attribute supplemental rules.

columns.name: PYA_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the prior year adjustment codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_PRIOR_YEAR_ADJUSTMENT lookup.

columns.name: BUDGET_OBJECT_CLASS
columns.description: The budget object class code defined in federal attribute supplemental rules.

columns.name: DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSABLE_CODE
columns.description: The direct or reimbursable code defined in federal fund attributes. It is based on the ORA_FV_DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSEABLE lookup. Valid values are D and R.

columns.name: DISASTER_EMERGENCY_FUND_CODE
columns.description: The disaster emergency fund code defined in federal attribute supplemental rules.

columns.name: PIID_NUMBER
columns.description: The procurement instrument identifier derived from the purchase order.

columns.name: PARENT_AWARD_NUMBER
columns.description: The parent award number derived from the purchase order.

columns.name: FAIN_NUMBER
columns.description: The federal award identification number derived from the purchase order.

columns.name: URI
columns.description: The uniform resource identifier derived from the purchase order.

columns.name: JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Journal entry header identifier.

columns.name: JE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Line on the supplier's response.

columns.name: REPORT_RUN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the file processing attributes.

columns.name: TREASURY_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL
columns.description: The identification code assigned by Treasury, in collaboration with Office of Management and Budget and the owner agency, to an individual appropriation, receipt, or other fund account.

columns.name: FUND_CODE
columns.description: An agency-defined shorthand code used to identify an individual appropriation, receipt, or other fund account or an agency subdivision of a Treasury Account Symbol.

columns.name: USSGL_ACCOUNT
columns.description: A six-digit number used to identify a specific U.S. Standard General Ledger account. The U.S. Standard General Ledger account must be in the U.S. Standard General Ledger chart of accounts.

columns.name: POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which journal batch was posted.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE
columns.description: Journal source. Foreign key to GL_JE_SOURCES_B.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Journal category. Foreign key to GL_JE_CATEGORIES_B.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting period. Foreign key to GL_PERIODS.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: Journal entry line debit amount in base currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: Journal entry line credit amount in base currency.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: Original debit amount in base currency for the journal entry line.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: Original credit amount in base currency for the journal entry line.

columns.name: JE_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Journal entry batch defining column.

columns.name: PROCESS_FILE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the DATA Act files that are processed for the journal line, for example, file B, file C, or both file B and file C.

columns.name: INCLUDE_BAL_CALC_FILE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies whether the journal line is included in the DATA Act balance calculations for file B, file C, or both file B and file C.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
